summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the Pontis candidate-side AI agent dashboard for Eve. All 3 columns, sidebar navigation tabs, onboarding tracker, voice intake simulation, interactive chat feed with Job Match Cards ('Not for me' and 'Track' actions), chat messaging, and the reconciled Living Profile with activation gate toggle were successfully tested and verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean 3-column architecture successfully implemented with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Interactive features including dynamic chat responses, onboarding progress updates, job tracking, and profile strength activation gate operate smoothly on local React state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pontis AI candidate dashboard is fully functional with mock data. No backend integration required as per specifications.
